legal_basis.presumptive_tax_upper_threshold: Income Tax Act (Cap 340), s.4(5) and Second Schedule

notes.paye_bands_resident: The top band is the 30% band plus the additional 10% charge on chargeable income above UGX 10,000,000 per month, expressed here as a single 40% marginal rate.
notes.customs_duty_common: Indicative EAC CET band for finished consumer goods. The binding rate is the tariff line for the specific HS code.
